column1: # AQL Language Specification: the aql:test module
# Format: input<TAB>expected<TAB>description
# Loadable testing framework. Import binds TWO namespaces: `Test` (the
# imperative API, declarative spec/case constructors, PBT driver, record
# types and result accessors) and `Assert` (the assertion words used
# inside test bodies). Usage: `import "aql:test"  Test.word args`.
# Test bodies run in a sub-engine; assertion words raise an
# `assertion_failure` error on failure which `Test.test` catches and
# records so later cases still run. State (results / fail-count) lives on
# the importing registry; use `end` to sequence statements. The spec
# clock is FROZEN at 2021-01-01T00:00:00Z so the rand-backed PBT rows are
# deterministic.
# §1  imperative API — test / it / describe accumulate TestResults
import "aql:test"  Test.test "adds" [(1 add 1) 2 Assert.equal] end Test.fail-count
import "aql:test"  Test.test "ok" [true Assert.ok] end Test.summary
import "aql:test"  Test.it "adds" [(1 add 1) 2 Assert.equal] end Test.fail-count
import "aql:test"  Test.describe "math" [Test.test "adds" [(1 add 1) 2 Assert.equal]] end Test.fail-count
# §2  results accessors — results / report / reset
import "aql:test"  Test.test "a" [1 1 Assert.equal] end Test.results size
import "aql:test"  Test.test "a" [1 1 Assert.equal] end (Test.report) typeof
import "aql:test"  Test.test "a" [1 1 Assert.equal] end Test.reset end Test.summary
# §3  Assert words — equal / not-equal / ok / match / throws
import "aql:test"  Test.test "eq" [(1 add 1) 2 Assert.equal] end Test.fail-count
column3: Assert.equal passes when both sides are equal

column1: import "aql:test"  Test.test "neq" [1 2 Assert.not-equal] end Test.fail-count
import "aql:test"  Test.test "ok-truthy" [5 Assert.ok] end Test.fail-count
column3: Assert.ok passes on any truthy value

column1: import "aql:test"  Test.test "match" [Assert.match "ell" "hello"] end Test.fail-count
column3: Assert.match passes when string contains substring

column1: import "aql:test"  Test.test "throws" [[1 0 div] Assert.throws] end Test.fail-count
column3: Assert.throws passes when its body raises

column1: import "aql:test"  Test.test "no-throw" [[1] Assert.throws] end Test.fail-count
column3: Assert.throws fails when the body does not raise

column1: # §4  spec runner — invoke / run-spec drive a subject under test
import "aql:test"  def double fn [[n:Integer] [Integer] [n 2 mul]] end [3] Test.invoke double/q
column3: `invoke` runs a subject word against an input list

column1: import "aql:test"  def double fn [[n:Integer] [Integer] [n 2 mul]] end def s {name: "doubling" subject: double/q cases: [{name: "d3" in: [3] out: 6} {name: "d0" in: [0] out: 0}] subs: []} end s Test.run-spec end Test.summary
column3: `run-spec` checks every case against the subject

column1: # §5  spec constructors — case / spec / spec-with-subs
import "aql:test"  (Test.case 6 [3] "d3") get "name"
import "aql:test"  (Test.case 6 [3] "d3") get "out"
import "aql:test"  (Test.spec [] double/q "doubling") get "name"
import "aql:test"  (Test.spec-with-subs [] [] double/q "outer") get "name"
# §6  property-based testing — prop / check-prop / run-property / skip
import "aql:test"  def p (Test.prop "nonneg" [r.int 0 100] [0 gte]) end p get "runs"
column3: `prop` builds a PropertySpec with default runs=100

column1: import "aql:test"  def p (Test.prop "nonneg" [r.int 0 100] [0 gte]) end (p Test.run-property) get "ok"
import "aql:test"  (Test.check-prop "nonneg" [r.int 0 100] [0 gte] 20 1 0) get "ok"
import "aql:test"  (Test.skip "wip" [r.int 0 9] [false] 10 1 0) get "skipped"
column3: `skip` records a parked property without running it

column1: # §7  record / table types — constructed via make, asserted via istype
import "aql:test"  (make Test.TestCase {name: "a" in: [1] out: 2}) get "out"
import "aql:test"  Test.TestCase istype
import "aql:test"  (make Test.TestSpec {name: "s" subject: foo/q cases: [] subs: []}) get "name"
import "aql:test"  Test.TestSpec istype
import "aql:test"  (make Test.TestResult {name: "t" path: [] ok: true expected: None actual: None error: None duration-ms: 0}) get "ok"
column3: TestResult record records a case outcome

column1: import "aql:test"  Test.TestResult istype
import "aql:test"  (make Test.PropertySpec {name: "p" gen: [] property: [] runs: 100 seed: 1 max-shrinks: 200}) get "runs"
import "aql:test"  Test.PropertySpec istype
import "aql:test"  (make Test.PropertyResult {name: "p" ok: true runs: 5 failing-input: None shrunk-input: None shrunk-source: "" shrunk-cost: 0 error: None}) get "ok"
column3: PropertyResult record records a property outcome

column1: import "aql:test"  Test.PropertyResult istype
import "aql:test"  (make Test.TestSet [[name: "a" in: [1] out: 2]]) is Test.TestSet
column3: TestSet is a Table over TestCase

column1: import "aql:test"  Test.TestSet istype
# §8  negative — a failed assertion raises assertion_failure
import "aql:test"  Assert.equal 1 2
# the namespaces are unbound until imported
Assert.equal 1 1
